data.description: Flexible alternative to Option (d) Gatekeeper that validates questions based on seeing option (d) OR ≥2 options. Useful for formats with inconsistent option counts or OCR errors. Current Gatekeeper works perfectly for Vision IAS (100/100 accuracy), so this is only needed if we encounter PDFs with missing option (d) or support multiple exam formats.
